info.name: RMA V3 API
info.description: Postman collection for the RMA V3 production API. Start with Login User for administrative requests. Login Customer replaces the cookie session for customer-only requests; run Login User again to switch back. Scripts retain CSRF/auth tokens when exposed, generate idempotency keys, and save created resource IDs.
